The '''Ilum Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]].
